group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-08-10: 'Aqeilan RI[au]' 137, 'Aqeilan RI[au] AND WWOX' 65.
group_assessment.weighting: Primary group for gene and disease, co-led here with a computational group (Davila-Velderrain). The observation and the interpretation separate cleanly in this paper and should be weighted apart: the organoid derivation, patient-line reprogramming and electrophysiology are the laboratory's own and carry its full weight; the single-cell inference, potency and cell-cycle analyses are the collaborator's and are the parts on which the WWOX-MYC thesis rests. Three of the paper's own statistics — no randomization or blinding, and scRNA-seq / MYC inhibition / ChIP-seq performed without independent differentiations — apply precisely to that second half.
group_assessment.note: Research-group knowledge base excluded from the public edition; this rests on measured counts, the Methods, the author contributions supplement and the statistics section.

field_density.note: Maximum density: human WWOX-deficient and patient-derived cerebral organoids from the gene's primary laboratory.

multihop.enumeration_method: Reference list parsed from the extracted text: 104 numbered entries, 86 carrying a DOI and none carrying a PMID in the accepted-manuscript format. Because the list is DOI-keyed rather than PMID-keyed, deduplication against the registry needs DOI resolution first — and FT-034 already recorded that a bibliography audit on a single key overstates its results in the direction that flatters it. Not attempted on one key here.
multihop.reason: Enumerated and explicitly not deduplicated. Recording the count and the reason the usual method does not apply is the honest state; running a PMID-keyed dedup against a DOI-keyed list would have produced a reassuring and meaningless number.

verbatim_locators.abstract_anchoring_waived: The accepted-manuscript surface carries no separately delimited abstract, and every proposition below is a methodological bound, a panel reading or a qualification of the central thesis — none of which an abstract would carry.
verbatim_locators.surface_note: 🔴 The extracted text interpolates LINE NUMBERS into the flow, because the source is a line-numbered accepted manuscript. A quote spanning a line break therefore contains a stray digit and fails verification. Nine of fifteen candidate snippets failed for exactly this reason and were shortened to fragments lying within one line, rather than the surface being normalised — cleaning it would launder the defect into every quote drawn from it, which is the standing rule for suspect surfaces applied to a benign but real one. Each snippet below is the longest fragment that verifies.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE CENTRAL PHENOTYPE IS ALMOST ENTIRELY IN THE ENGINEERED KNOCKOUT, NOT IN THE PATIENT LINES. Figure 2F plots cell-fraction log2FC against WT: the WWOX-KO loses neurons at about -2.6 log2FC with radial glia up about +0.55, while SCAR12 and WOREE both sit within roughly ±0.2 of WT on both populations. entries.proposition: 🔴 THE FUNCTIONAL PILLAR IS NOT MYC-SELECTIVE. The MYC-inhibition experiment uses A51, which the paper itself describes as a multi-kinase inhibitor suppressing both Wnt and MYC, at 125 nM from week 8 to week 15. Any causal attribution to MYC inherits that ambiguity. It is also the first pharmacological intervention in a human WWOX-deficient neural model in this corpus — IPOTESI-level material for the therapeutic track, and a BLOCK-1 question if ever promoted.

entries.proposition: 🔴 WOREE AND SCAR12 ARE TRANSCRIPTIONALLY NEAR-INDISTINGUISHABLE IN NEURONAL CELLS. The direct WOREE-versus-SCAR12 volcano carries essentially nothing past the |logFC| 0.5 threshold — two ribosomal genes on the down side and no up-regulated gene at all — while each line against WT yields a dozen or more. The clinical gradient between the severe and the mild syndrome does not appear as a transcriptional difference in this model. That is a limit of the organoid platform for severity work, and it converges with PMID 36779245's finding of no evidence for an intermediate phenotype.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE THERAPY DOES NOT RETURN LAYER MARKERS TO WILD TYPE — IT OVERSHOOTS THEM. In treated WOREE organoids SATB2 mRNA sits about ten-fold above wild type and BCL11B/CTIP2 about three-fold, with the untreated WOREE line below wild type on both. The brackets run WT-versus-EGFP and EGFP-versus-WWOX; the WT-versus-treated comparison is not drawn, for the third time in this paper. This is what the figure's title means by 'affects cortical layer marker expression', and it is the half the safety sentence omits. The radial-glia half is confirmed by the same figure: the untreated-versus-treated volcano in radial glia shows no gene passing threshold, and the cell-cycle densities superimpose.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE MYC-INHIBITION RESCUE IS PARTIAL AND SELECTIVE, AND THE PANEL SEPARATES WHAT THE TEXT JOINS. A51 normalises the progenitor compartment and the pan-neuronal marker but does nothing for either layer marker. SOX2+ cells fall from about 60 percent in the knockout to about 33 with A51, ns against wild type; SOX2+MYC+ double positives from about 72 to about 50, ns against wild type; NEUN+ neurons recover from about 6 percent to about 18, significant against the untreated knockout and ns against wild type. But SATB2+ shows ns between knockout and A51, and CTIP2+ shows ns between knockout and A51 while remaining **** below wild type. So inhibiting MYC restores progenitor identity and pan-neuronal marking, and leaves deep- and superficial-layer neuron production where it was. Any claim that MYC inhibition rescues neurogenesis has to carry that split — and the compound is in any case not MYC-selective.

entries.proposition: 🔴 TWO THINGS FROM ONE PAGE. First, the proliferation phenotype is graded exactly as the composition phenotype was: mitotic progenitors run about 3 percent in WT, about 10 in the engineered knockout with ****, about 6 in WOREE with *, and about 4.5 in SCAR12 with no bracket drawn at all. Third independent measure on which the knockout carries the effect and the patient lines trail far behind it. Second, and new: the AAV9 rescue overshoots downward as well as upward. TCF-4 protein reads 1 in wild type, 1.3 to 3.1 across the mutant lines, and 0.3 in the AAV9-rescued knockout — a third of wild type. Set beside SATB2 at about ten-fold above wild type in Supplementary Figure 10, the pattern is that neuronal restoration displaces these markers rather than normalising them, in whichever direction.

entries.proposition: 🔴 QUALIFIES MY OWN CLAIM, WHICH WAS TOO FLAT. I recorded three times that the phenotype is almost entirely the engineered knockout's, from composition, from the WOREE-versus-SCAR12 transcriptome and from proliferation. In RADIAL GLIA that is wrong: MYC is up in all three lines at comparable magnitude — pseudobulk logFC on WT of about 1.8 for the knockout, 1.65 for WOREE and 1.6 for SCAR12 — and both patient volcanoes carry MYC past threshold alongside SFRP1 and H4C3, with PTN, VIM, NR2F2 and EDNRB down in both. So the molecular lesion in the progenitor compartment IS shared by the patient lines. What the knockout carries disproportionately is the downstream consequence — cell composition and neuronal output — not the MYC activation itself. The correct statement is narrower than the one I committed: MYC activation in radial glia is shared; its impact on neuron production is not.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE PATIENT GENOTYPES, AND ONE OF THEM IS A SPLICE-ACCEPTOR ALLELE THIS CORPUS CARES ABOUT. Five patient lines are tabulated with their variants: WOREE — WSM S is NM_016373.4:c.517-2A>G homozygous, LM-iPS is c.864G>A over a 16q23.1 deletion of about 93 kb, WCH S is compound heterozygous c.410G>T p.Gly137Val with c.517-2A>G; SCAR12 — WPM S and WPM D both c.1114G>C homozygous. c.517-2A>G is a canonical splice-acceptor variant carried by two independent WOREE lines, one homozygous and one in trans. That makes characterised, AAV-transducible human neural material available for a splice-acceptor allele class, which is the class the ASO track in this repository is built around.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE RESCUE DOES NOT CONTROL ITS OWN EXPRESSION LEVEL, AND THIS QUANTIFIES THE OVERSHOOT PATTERN. WWOX protein after AAV9 rescue, relative to wild type = 1, ranges from 0.4 to 7 depending on the line: SCAR12 WPM S1 goes from 0.1 untreated to 7 after AAV9; WOREE lines reach 0.4 to 0.9; the engineered knockouts reach 0.8 and 1.4. A seventeen-fold spread across lines treated with the same vector. Together with SATB2 at about ten-fold above wild type and TCF-4 at 0.3, the pattern recorded across this paper is not that the rescue overshoots in one direction but that it does not set a level at all.
